title: n-D Lookup Table
text: Approximate n-dimensional function, 6 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Number of table dimensions} sets Number of lookup table dimensions; {Data specification} sets the method of table and breakpoint specification Table, {Name}, {Breakpoints specification} sets the method of breakpoint specification Explicit, {Support tunable size} sets the option to enable tunable table size, {Source}, {Tunable size} sets the maximum number of elements for each array, {Table data} defines the table of output values reshape, {Breakpoints} sets the explicit breakpoint values or first point and spacing of breakpoints, {First point}, {Spacing}, {Edit table and breakpoints} sets the open Lookup Table Editor, {Interpolation method} sets the method of interpolation between breakpoint values Linear, {Extrapolation method} sets the method of handling input values that fall outside the range of a breakpoint vector, {Index search method} sets the method of calculating table indices Binary, {Apply more accurate and efficient rounding when possible} sets the more accurate fixed-point table lookup using efficient round, {Begin index search using previous index result} sets the start using the index from the previous time, {Assume input is within range} sets the option to check for out-of-range input, {Diagnostic for out-of-range input} sets the block action when input is out of range, {Apply full precision fixed-point algorithm when possible} sets the more accurate fixed-point table lookup, {Use last table value for inputs at or above last breakpoint} sets the method for computing output for inputs at or above last, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Use one input port for all input data} uses only one input port, {Table data Minimum} sets the minimum value of the table data, {Table data Maximum} sets the maximum value of the table data, {Breakpoints Minimum} sets the minimum value breakpoint data can have, {Breakpoints Maximum} sets the maximum value breakpoint data can have, {Fraction}, {Intermediate results}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value for range checking, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value for range checking, {Internal rule priority} sets the internal rule for intermediate calculations, {Require all inputs to have the same data type}, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.
